event_summary: A gray sphere enters from the left across a tabletop, reaches a brown-and-orange pair, and the orange sphere moves to the right out of view.
raw_event_description: At the beginning, a brown short cylindrical object and an orange sphere are next to each other on a light wood tabletop near the upper middle-right area, while a black cylindrical object is partly visible at the far left edge. After a period with no visible change, a gray sphere appears from the left and moves rightward across the table. The gray sphere reaches the brown object and orange sphere; the three objects briefly appear close together. The orange sphere then separates and moves rightward toward and beyond the right edge of the frame. The gray sphere and brown object remain on the tabletop near the center-right area with little further visible movement.

reasons: The tabletop and two central objects are clearly visible before the later moving gray sphere appears.
The orange sphere and brown cylindrical object are already positioned next to each other.
The gray sphere is not yet visible in the first frame.
